description: Insurance Board of Sri Lanka - Rules made to amend the Insurance Board of Sri Lanka Rules of 2005 published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1412/30 of 29.11.2005
reasoning: This gazette content contains rules made by the Insurance Board of Sri Lanka under the Regulation of Insurance Industry Act, No. 43 of 2000. It involves amendments to existing regulations governing the qualifications and experience requirements for principal officers in insurance companies and insurance brokering companies. This falls under "Legal/Regulatory Gazettes" as it deals with regulatory frameworks, compliance requirements, and amendments to existing rules governing the insurance industry.
